description: Kiln's shipped compatibility rules: installed as <game>/kiln/compat-rules.json (tools/package/stage.sh, component core; tools/deploy-server.sh, tools/client/client.sh) and replaced by every update. Your own rules go in <configDir>/compat-rules.json; one with the same id replaces a rule here. Docs: docs/kiln/engines/README.md#closed-source-dll-mods.

rules.message: Item Skill Descriptions can check the game's original code while Auto Doors keeps its hooks.
Ultimate ASI Loader loads after Kiln so that Auto Loot Plus can hook the game first; Auto Loot Plus's F8 menu needs that.

Live Map (IPHLPAPI.DLL in the game folder, a stand-alone server map) hooks a few game functions before Kiln (players/RegisterSingleton, time.daytime_update); Kiln chains over its hooks and both run. Nothing to fix.

Creative Mode (creative.dll; 3.2.0 seen) and Building Tools clash in the game client, not through Kiln: Creative Mode rewrites the game's HUD screen dispatch (enshrouded.exe +0xC60A22 on 1.0.1.2) for its own menu, and Building Tools looks for those very bytes once, 4 s after it loads, to add its own screen. Building Tools' menu (Home), tools wheel (Caps Lock) and exact placement window then stay off; its other keys still work. To use them, switch Creative Mode off in the profile (Kiln's own /creative does not touch that code), or ask either mod's author: Building Tools could follow Creative Mode's jump there.
